summary: Work Orders – Finance Tab Fails to Load
reported_issue: Opening the Finance tab on a work order (reported on WO S-1032) throws an error and the invoice fails to load; the Finance view remains blank or stuck on an error state.
expected_after_fix: Finance tab should load and display the invoice/financial info for the work order without errors.
steps_i_followed: The exact reported WO S-1032 (Tombstone Diesel & Iron) is production data not present on staging, so tested the general Finance-tab flow across multiple staging WOs.
Opened a paid WO (S9-24674) and navigated to /workorders/{id}/finance.
Opened an invoiced WO (S9-24669) Finance tab.
Captured the rendered Finance panel content and a screenshot.
actual_now: The Finance tab loads correctly. For paid WO S9-24674 the tab rendered a complete invoice preview (Invoice INV-S9-24674, invoice date, Bill To, Remit payment to, line/parts breakdown, totals). No console errors were thrown (0 errors) and the page stayed on the /finance route. The invoiced WO also loaded its Finance tab cleanly. Only an 'approved' (not-yet-invoiced) WO returned a 500 and redirected to the list, which is expected since no invoice exists yet — not the reported blank/error state on an invoiced WO.
notes: The specific production WO S-1032 could not be loaded on staging (disposable staging shop). Verdict is based on the general Finance-tab flow working across multiple paid/invoiced WOs with no error state. Confidence medium because the exact original record was not reproducible.
